name: flame.github/get-issue.v1
description: Read one GitHub issue or pull request by its repository and issue number.

name: flame.github/list-issues.v1
description: Read one explicit page of repository issues and pull requests, exposing the next page number supplied by GitHub.

name: flame.github/read-file.v1
description: Read a UTF-8 repository file up to one MiB, optionally at an exact Git ref. Directory and binary content are refused.
